metadata.description: Log Analytics workspace name that Microsoft Sentinel is enabled on
Resource name of the analytics rule 'M365 - OAuth Consent to High-Risk Scopes'

properties.displayName: M365 - OAuth Consent to High-Risk Scopes
properties.description:
Detects user- or admin-granted OAuth consent to an application that requests
high-risk scopes (Mail.Read, Mail.ReadWrite, Files.ReadWrite.All,
offline_access, ...). Illicit-consent grant phishing (e.g. PerfectData,
eM Client lookalikes) is a dominant BEC vector.

Scope note: this rule detects *high-risk scope consent*, not "unverified
publisher". AuditLogs does not expose the publisher-verification flag, so
publisher status is a triage step, not a detection predicate. The rule name
reflects what the query can actually prove.
properties.query:
let high_risk_scopes = dynamic([
  "Mail.Read","Mail.ReadWrite","Mail.Send","MailboxSettings.ReadWrite",
  "Files.Read.All","Files.ReadWrite.All","Sites.ReadWrite.All",
  "offline_access","User.Read.All","Directory.Read.All","Contacts.Read"
]);
let excluded_apps = dynamic([]);
AuditLogs
| where TimeGenerated > ago(1h)
| where OperationName == "Consent to application"
| extend Actor = tostring(InitiatedBy.user.userPrincipalName)
| extend AppName = tostring(TargetResources[0].displayName)
| extend AppId = tostring(TargetResources[0].id)
| where AppId !in (excluded_apps)
| mv-expand mod = TargetResources[0].modifiedProperties
| extend PropName = tostring(mod.displayName), NewValue = tostring(mod.newValue)
| where PropName == "ConsentAction.Permissions"
| extend Scopes = NewValue
| extend IsAdminConsent = NewValue has "AdminConsent=True"
| where Scopes has_any (high_risk_scopes)
| project TimeGenerated, Actor, AppName, AppId, IsAdminConsent, Scopes

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: OAuth consent to high-risk scopes for {{AppName}}
alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: {{Actor}} granted {{AppName}} access to high-risk scopes. Verify the publisher and the requested permissions before removing the consent grant.
